**Held items landed (afc5ed4) — audited-tip anchoring, throwing per-merge reads, SIG drift-guard + corrected fail-open direction**

**What**: The three items rev 4 held behind guard `(c′)` landed as **`afc5ed4`** (7 files, +333/−21) on `feat/issue-259-d2-pr3-net-parity-reverter-skip`. NOT pushed at time of writing. Suite **1821/1821** (was 1809), `repo:check` clean, four-fixture matrix unchanged.

**MINOR 1 — audited-tip anchoring**: new pure helper `auditedTip(range)` in `brain/scripts/lib/audit-helpers.mjs`. `resolveRange` accepts an arbitrary range from argv but the skips asked "net-absent at `'HEAD'`?" regardless — auditing a non-HEAD tip answered a question about a different commit. GOTCHA in the parser: the **three-dot split must run FIRST**, otherwise `'A...B'` splits on `'..'` into `['A', '.B']` and returns a ref with a stray leading dot. `resolvedSkipLine` now REQUIRES `tip` and THROWS without it — no default, per owner doctrine #964 (an exported guard whose soundness depends on the caller is unsound by design).

**MINOR 2 — throwing per-merge reads**: `numstat`/`changedFiles`/`body`/`parents` used a `git()` helper returning `''` on ANY failure → empty diff → `diffSize` + `adrPresence` PASS (silent fail-open). The swallowing helper is **DELETED**, not bypassed. Added `.trim()` at each call site — `gitOrThrow` does not trim and `selectIssueLinkBody` treats `'\n'` as truthy, so dropping the trim silently changes issueLink behavior.

**KEY FINDING — why MINOR 2 has no behavioral test, verified not assumed**: every hermetic way to break `git diff` in a fixture ALSO breaks the range-load or the resolved-skip, both of which already exit 2 → the test would pass against the UNFIXED code and prove nothing. Empirically checked: `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` with `diff.algorithm=bogusalgo` fails `git log --first-parent --merges` too (exit 128), not just the diff. Guarded by source scan instead, and the thread says so plainly.

**SIG drift-guard + corrected risk direction**: the in-code note claimed drifting COARSER yields at worst an EXTRA `[FAIL-SHA]`. **INVERTED** — coarser ⇒ more dedup-key COLLISIONS ⇒ the second payload's `[FAIL-SHA]` is SUPPRESSED (missed emission, fail-open for PR4's consumer). `crossCheckExit` compares booleans (`>0`) so it can never detect partial suppression. Comment corrected + source-scan fence added.

**Test-design gotcha worth keeping**: the first drift-guard compared the pin arrays as normalized TEXT and failed on formatting alone (`SIG_CONFIG` is one line, `HARDENED_CONFIG` is multi-line with a trailing comma). Fixed to extract the quoted entries and `deepEqual` the VALUES. A guard that reddens on a line break is a guard nobody keeps.

**Mutation bar forged**: dropping `--binary` from the mirror reddens the drift-guard (1 pass / 1 fail).

**Records**: `brain/core/anti-patterns/local-mirror-of-a-frozen-pin.md` (indexed in that dir's README — `brain:nav` requires it) and `design.md §15.5a`.

**Next**: push, report on #297, then the PR — which still needs a size/chained story (pre-push warns ~10k lines vs the 400 budget). The modification-shaped attack is still owed to the finder.</content>
